defects.claim: Acceptance bullet 2 is not met. The PR body has no "Needs API" section, so none of the `—` fields or the endpoints that would supply them are listed. These fields are Docs `Created this week` and `Read by Pilot this week` (ContextPanel.vue:37,39), all three Memory rows plus the Memory header (ContextPanel.vue:42-44,84), and Graph Nodes, Edges, Last updated and health (ContextPanel.vue:61-63). Evidence: the PR body has only Summary, Changes (a copy of the issue) and Evidence; it never names a missing field or endpoint.

The Docs header shows `docs.entries.length` and "Updated this week" counts `entries` (ContextPanel.vue:33). The type contract warns against recounting entries: src/lib/api/types.ts:644-645 "never client-recount `entries`, the tree response may cap/paginate individual entries independently of these totals (`?limit=` on the tree call)". A capped tree would give a low total that looks like a real number.

The health thresholds (≤7d Healthy, ≤30d Drift, older Stale) are made up by the client. The docblock admits "Health rule (assumed — no backend definition exists yet)". Today nothing passes `graph` (DashboardView.vue:367 `<ContextPanel :docs="contextDocs" />`), so this code never runs. Still, the rule should go to the backend under "Needs API" and not ship as the tooltip text.

Below 768px the panel is not shown at all. The grid holding ContextPanel is `hidden ... md:grid`, and the mobile branch at DashboardView.vue:373 (`<div v-if="!loading && !error" class="md:hidden">`) has no ContextPanel. So it stacks below the main column only between 768 and 1279px.

Failures are dropped silently and "not running", "no .agent dir" and "no instance" all show the same `—`. This matches the issue's fallback rule, but nothing on screen tells the user why the numbers are missing. DocsView.vue:115-119 does split these cases (`if (err.code === 'not_running') treeState.value = 'not-running'`).

Acceptance bullet 2 is not met: the body has no "Needs API" section. It has only Summary, Changes (the issue text pasted again) and Evidence, so nothing lists the fields that fall back to `—` (Docs Created/Read this week; all of Memory; Graph Nodes/Edges/Last updated/health) or the endpoint that would have to supply each. The issue scope says: "list the missing fields in the PR body under 'Needs API'".
